description: The Urban Studio data a Windows portable package carries (tools/urban_portable.py collect): the Tocho and Sapporo Cities and the three scenes to try first (showcase/urban: Compositions, routes, the flight plan and the people scene), as this Workspace has them (tools/urban_demo_worlds.py build --showcase --tocho --sapporo makes them there). The detailed verification demos (demos/) are not carried. Paths are relative to the Business Pack work directory ($HAKONIWA_WORK_DIR); collect also takes every file these reference there, and replaces the absolute paths in them with placeholders that prepare fills in for the extraction folder.
